main_text.head: QUÆST. 3.

head.i: Utrum duellum religionis gratiâ suscæptum, sit licitum ?

main_text.p: ADeo altas radices religio hominum animis infixit, adeoque effervescens est eorum circa religionem amor, ut licet zelo inordinato , ea omnia probanda existument, quæ pro ecclesiâ fiunt, quæ ipsi pro religione faciunt. Unde etiam duella suscipi posse censent cum hominibus impiis, & in Deum supra modum injuriis. Præsertim, si eam quam profitentur religionem, calu-mniis, ac dicteriis gravare, atq; conspurcare satagant. Dicen-dum,

page.notes: The drop capital "A" is a large woodcut-style initial, joined to "Deo" as "ADeo". The question line "licitum ?" keeps the space before the question mark as printed. Two faint marks on the left margin and a faint stamp at the bottom right are not printed text and are left out. Where the running text ends the paragraph at "Dicen-dum," the sentence continues on the next page; no catchword is printed.
